outcome: Gestational age at full oral feeding
Postnatal age at full oral feeding
cohort: The study included 122 infants born below 32 weeks of gestation and admitted to a level III neonatal unit in 2015.
finding: Duration of non-invasive ventilation, oxygen therapy, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, and patent ductus arteriosus were associated with an older age at full oral feeding, with bronchopulmonary dysplasia being the single most potent predictor.
